changelog:
Initial release of nansen-fund-tracker.

- Track cross-chain crypto fund and VC portfolios in real-time.
- View top token holdings and portfolio changes for "smart money" on Ethereum and Solana.
- Analyze net accumulation signals with holdings and netflow data.
- Simple CLI commands via `nansen` binary; requires NANSEN_API_KEY.
summary: What are crypto funds and VCs holding right now? Cross-chain fund portfolios and net accumulation signals.
